Book Maggie’s Munchies for Your Event

Planning a corporate event, a wedding, a private party, or a school sporting event? Maggie’s Munchies serves REAL Old-Fashioned 1/4 LB New England Cookies™ from our cookie trailer across New Hampshire and New England. We have multiple setup options available: our cookie trailer, an outdoor tent-and-table setup, and indoor table setups. Companies book us for appreciation days, team gatherings, and client gifts. Venues, breweries, and property managers: ask about a pop-up visit, where our trailer comes to you and guests buy their own.
